description: The Western geomantic Shield Chart apparatus — the full medieval divination toolkit: generating the four Mothers, deriving Daughters, Nieces, Witnesses and the Judge by binary addition, the 16 figures and their elemental/planetary rulerships, Via Punctorum (the Way of Points and its hidden protagonist), the House Chart with astrological correspondences, perfection techniques (occupation, conjunction, mutation, translation), triplicities, telesmatic personification, and Telesma generation. A method-skill: a menu of moves to improvise a living reading from, NOT a form to fill out. Use when asked for a geomantic reading, a Shield Chart, a casting of the figures (Populus, Via, Fortuna Major, etc.), or to read a question through Western geomancy. Triggers on: 'geomantic reading', 'cast a Shield Chart', 'the four Mothers', 'geomancy', 'Witnesses and Judge', 'the sixteen figures', 'Via Punctorum'. Kin: /wen-wang-gua, /chronosemiology, /oracular-voice, /elemental-phenomenology, /collision.
